study: Q-SHIFT CNN architecture Stage 2 development comparison
scientific_scope: development-only comparison; no confirmatory claim; no independent-test access

synthetic_spatial_burst.injection: CORRELATED_ERROR X on data qubits 8 and 10 after each MR boundary

burst_informed_pymatching.circuit: synthetic spatial burst condition with p=0.01 at the declared pair and round boundaries
burst_informed_pymatching.information_status: privileged model-informed reference; receives the generating burst specification

inference_inputs: 40 detector bits in the real Stim geometry
training.condition_pooling: 10,000 training shots from each condition per root; equal-condition pooled data; condition is sampler/stratification metadata only and is not a model input
training.balancing_scope: separately within each condition, using the residual target; replacement is allowed for a rare class
training.natural_prevalence_logit_correction: add logit of the pooled natural residual prevalence measured on that root's training data, as in the historical training implementation
training.checkpoint_selection: minimum equal-condition monitor NLL; restore best weights before calibration/threshold selection

selection.temperature_objective: minimum equal-condition calibration NLL; ties prefer temperature nearest 1.0, then lower value
selection.threshold_objective: minimum equal-condition threshold-selection logical error rate; ties prefer threshold nearest 0.5, then lower value
selection.final_development_rule: load final-development labels only after model checkpoint, temperature, and threshold are persisted; score exactly once; no choices updated afterward

analysis.primary_comparison: equal-condition, per-root paired LER difference (primary CNN minus nominal_fixed_pymatching)
analysis.root_level_interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval across five independent root-level paired effects; descriptive feasibility interval only
analysis.secondary_inference: descriptive paired effects and root-level intervals; no superiority claim or post-hoc winner selection

development_gate.interpretation: development feasibility gate only; passing does not establish statistical superiority or authorize independent-test access

analysis.burst_reference: compare and report only on burst-condition paired shots; it is privileged and not deployable without the burst specification

rare_residual_target_safeguards.action_if_below_minimum: stop before fitting that root; do not top up, resample, or inspect final-development labels
rare_residual_target_safeguards.limitation: balanced sampling can repeatedly reuse rare positive examples; monitor NLL and early stopping do not remove this sampling-variance risk

resources.hardware_reference: RTX 4050 Laptop GPU 6 GB; no throughput claim until an execution dry run is completed
resources.device_policy: CUDA required; no silent CPU fallback

prohibitions: no training or sampling before a separate execution authorization and runner validation
no model selection on final-development data
no claim of superiority from this development study
